title: 3+1D Spin-1/2 space groups
scope: The full infinite affine group and primitive translations are retained. E8 data use the selected section and signed integer H1. The Song–Xiong–Huang column compares only the e1 layer, not the full electronic stacking group. The physical CI-kernel identification remains conditional.
